data.title: 墨染希 · 枫林私汤的绯红水汽
data.description: 后山深处的私人温泉被层层枫树环绕，绯红落叶铺满池畔。希浸泡在温热的泉水里，白皙的肩颈在水雾中泛着迷人的浅粉。当水声轻响时，她下意识将泉水捧起遮在身前，水滴自发梢滴落，眼中既有害羞也有期待已久的深情。

data.lighting: golden dusk glowing through crimson maple leaves
data.promptProse: Surrounded by crimson maple trees and fallen autumn leaves beside a quiet mountain spring, Nozomi pauses in the steaming water as golden sunset light filters through the branches. Water drips from her wet hair tips as she meets the viewer's gaze with shy warmth.
data.animaCaption: Soaking nude in a secluded mountain hot spring framed by red autumn maples at sunset, she lifts cupped water defensively before her chest and looks toward the viewer with a shy warm blush.
data.nsfwProse: Unclothed in the clear steaming hot spring up to her chest, she raises wet hands toward her collarbones while droplets glisten over her bare flushed shoulders.
